parameters.query:
select
  s.telefono,
  s.current_step,
  s.data,
  s.last_message_id,
  $2::text as incoming_text,
  $3::text as message_type,

  case
    when c.id is not null then true
    else false
  end as candidate_exists,

  to_jsonb(c) as candidate_profile

from public.candidate_sessions s
left join public.candidates c
  on c.telefono = s.telefono
where s.telefono = $1
limit 1;
